{{Top|leg}} {{Species |image=[[File:Skullofbigsize.jpg]] |name=Gargantelle |designation=[[Sentience/Legends|Sentient]]''[[Star Wars: Obsession]]'' |class=[[Humanoid/Legends|Humanoid]]''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' |subspecies= |races= |height=20 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] |length= |wingspan= |mass= |skincolor= |haircolor= |feathers= |eyecolor= |distinctions=Six [[Limb/Legends|arms]], one or two [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] |lifespan= |origin=[[Boz Pity/Legends|Boz Pity]] |habitat= |diet= |language= }} {{Quote|The people of this system were giants, we think.|Obi-Wan Kenobi|}} The '''Gargantelles''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of six-[[Limb/Legends|armed]] [[Giantism|giants]] that inhabited [[Boz Pity/Legends|Boz Pity]] until their extermination at the beginning of the [[Ductavis Era]]. ==Biology and appearance== The Gargantelles of [[Boz Pity/Legends|Boz Pity]] were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]], [[Giantism|giant]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] whose height topped 20 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. They had six beefy [[Limb/Legends|arms]] and, from what could be observed on their remains, their [[Skeleton/Legends|skeleton]] included a rib cage. They had overall very [[Human/Legends|Human]]-like facial features, with a mildly protruding [[Nose/Legends|nose]] bearing two nostrils and a [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]] with fleshy lips. Although Gargantelles normally had a single, forward-facing [[Eye/Legends|eye]], some had two. ==Society and culture== {{Quote|What is this place?''"
"''I read it's some sort of graveyard planet. But the size of the memorials…|Bail Organa and Anakin Skywalker|}} Although the Gargantelles were civilized enough to erect statues in honor of their dead, they were still very brutal. They would not hesitate to eat their smaller enemies as a means of resistance. Gargantelles of importance wore spiked [[Armor/Legends|helmets]] with a nose-guard. ==History== When the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] identified the giants of Boz Pity as potential [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]], they sent many [[Starship/Legends|ships]], attempting to capture the Gargantelle populace. Desperate to come out victorious, the Hutts threw seven invasions of [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] at the Gargantelles, but each invasion failed. They then sent [[t'landa Til]] negotiators, yet these negotiators suffered the same fate as the Nikto—killed and eaten by the enormous Gargantelles. In retaliation, the Hutts sent a group of [[Nimbanel/Legends|Nimbanel]] lawyers to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Mourn]], to procure the use of [[Sultan/Legends|Sultan]] [[Nastuonodon]]'s long forgotten [[Electric Caliph|electric caliphs]], pitting the army against the natives of Boz Pity. Over the next decade, Boz Pity was slowly depopulated by the [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. The Gargantelles built large memorials for their fallen, and their world became a graveyard planet. When most of the giants were slain, the droids returned to Mourn and destroyed themselves, seeing no further reason to exist. ==Behind the scenes== The Gargantelles first appeared in the [[2004]]–[[2005]] comic series ''[[Star Wars: Obsession]]'', in the form their bones and statues. Their history was expanded in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book. In the latter book, Gargantelles were referred to as "one-eyed giants," whereas the original comic book clearly depicted two-eyed skulls. ==Appearances== *[[Obsession 5|''Obsession'' 5]] {{1st}} {{C|Bones only}} ==Sources== *''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' {{1stID|Gargantelle}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Gargantelle |fr=Gargantelle }} [[Category:Extinct sentient species]] [[Category:Mid Rim sentient species]]
